ai_view.directive: Follow as written. Never trade an accurate set of partial truths for one confident but unsupported explanation.
ai_view.specification: Extend the causal-trace spec (naya5/causal-trace, in build) with the uncertainty representation: four independent dimensions (observability, evidence state, blocker state, causal state) never collapsed; multi-hypothesis causal graph with non-exclusive branches; scoped observability claims per source/type/resource/interval (COVERED_COMPLETE/PARTIAL, UNOBSERVED, CONFLICTED_COVERAGE, NOT_APPLICABLE); claim-level propositions with SUPPORTED/REFUTED/CONFLICTED/UNDETERMINED/NOT_APPLICABLE verdicts; blocker combinations with AND/OR logic and minimal blocking sets; hypotheses as competing revisable claims with relationships and discriminating tests; machine-readable causal uncertainty record; evidence-support-set recomputation on eligibility change; next-test selection by distinguishing power; anti-gaming acceptance suite. Extend existing contracts (uncertainty.py, propagation.py, liveness.py, causal trace) — no competing evidence store.

decisions: Shawn's explicit framework, main chat, 2026-10-10. His word IS the verification (Verification Law).

Folded as an EXTENSION of the in-build causal-trace layer (naya5/causal-trace), not a separate 13th layer — per his framework's own direction to extend existing contracts, not introduce competing stores.
intelligence.essence: NayaNET must never trade an accurate set of partial truths for one confident but unsupported explanation. Represent an incident as an evidence-bound set of observations, uncertainties, blockers and competing causal hypotheses — not as a single failure_reason field. Record what was observed, what could not be observed, what the evidence supports, what remains possible, and what would distinguish the remaining explanations. Assign responsibility only to the scope the evidence actually establishes. Not observed ≠ did not happen. Conflicting evidence ≠ evidence of a tie. A confirmed blocker ≠ the sole cause. An unresolved hypothesis ≠ a false hypothesis. A reported fault ≠ verified responsibility.
intelligence.falsifier: A single ROOT_CAUSE label on a multi-blocker incident; absence of an event in an unobserved interval treated as proof it never happened; two reports of different handoff stages manufactured into a contradiction; one blocker repaired and the workflow falsely declared complete; an unresolved hypothesis promoted to a verified lesson through repetition.

human_view.meaning: When the evidence is messy, don't force a clean story. Keep four separate books: what we could see, what the evidence says, what's blocking progress, and which explanations are still alive. Two blockers can both be real. Two explanations can both be possible. A missing log doesn't mean nothing happened — it means we couldn't see. And fixing one problem doesn't mean the job is done if another blocker is still standing. The most trustworthy answer is sometimes: 'two blockers confirmed, one interval unobservable, two explanations unresolved — here's what we can fix, and here's what we'd need to know more.'

intelligence.learning_lesson: This is the uncertainty companion to the causal trace (SN-0780): the trace proves what happened; this preserves what can't yet be proven. Together with the Freshness Law (old proof is history, not authority) they form the complete honesty discipline: establish what you can, preserve what you can't, never invent the rest. The support-set recomputation rule ('uncertainty follows dependencies') is the same principle as SN-0759's propagation — one law, two applications.

machine_view.spec_only: Framework ratified; extends the in-build causal-trace spec. Not wired into live paths until the integration phases reach it.

intelligence.measurement_contract: Anti-gaming suite as executable tests: missing logs + incomplete coverage → no never-happened inference; two reports of different handoff stages → no manufactured conflict; genuine contradictory independent observations → CONFLICTED preserved; two simultaneous blockers → both preserved; one blocker repaired, another remains → workflow stays blocked (the most important test); repeated unsupported hypothesis → no promotion through repetition; valid independent alternative evidence → narrower supported conclusion preserved; evidence becomes ineligible → recompute only dependents; counterexample refutes mechanism → downgrade/refute hypothesis; labels swapped → verdict unchanged. Decisive experiment: two blockers + missing interval + competing explanations + alternative path + single-blocker intervention — verifier preserves all uncertainties, recognizes the partial repair, never declares completion, names the discriminating evidence.

naya_view.directive: Keep observability, evidence state, blocker state, and causal state as four independent dimensions — never collapse them. Track observability per source, event type, resource, and interval with coverage evidence. Decompose conflicting reports into precise propositions before judging contradiction. Represent blockers with AND/OR combinations and minimal blocking sets. Treat hypotheses as competing, revisable, related claims each naming its discriminating test. Recompute conclusions through evidence-support sets when eligibility changes. Choose the next test for distinguishing power, crediting verified uncertainty reduction.

simple_view.meaning: Say what you know, say what you don't, keep every live possibility open, and never make up a clean answer from messy evidence.

intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor inherits the four-dimension discipline and the support-set recomputation rule, so partial evidence can never again collapse into a false single cause.
intelligence.uncertainty: Framework ratified; spec extension not yet built. Exact merge point with the causal-trace spec internals is the builder's call.
